scope: Interpretation audit of PR-035; no new outcomes.

structuralFact.rrLaterComparator: raw rewardPerRisk after post-consensus priorityScore tie
structuralFact.consequence: RR-based reward proxy is not independent of the allocation rule because RR is already an input to PriorityScore and later ordering.

partialNotTotalCircularity.evidence: 6133 has higher RR and RR score contribution than 3105, yet lower final PriorityScore and lower current allocation. Therefore RR does not determine the allocation ordering by itself.
partialNotTotalCircularity.implication: PR-035 remains a valid description of plan geometry, but cannot independently validate the economic merit of PriorityScore sizing.

correctedInterpretation.previousStrongReading: Current sizing receives independent ex-ante reward compensation for its additional planned risk.
correctedInterpretation.safeReading: Current sizing is structurally aligned with a higher RR-based reward-space proxy on 2026-09-18, but that alignment is partly endogenous because RR participates in the sizing score. It is a consistency diagnostic, not independent alpha evidence.
correctedInterpretation.requiredIndependentTest: Prospective realized outcomes controlling for raw RR and consensus contribution, plus fixed allocation counterfactuals and date-cluster/LODO.
